items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: And when Jack was with us they had to look up and there was Sammy.

ctx.x: Well, you know, okay, if you want to call it that, you know. You know, he dabbles in -- you know, he'll get on the drums and do a few things, and you'll get the bongo and you know, they sound like Jack Costanza because that's who he used to hang around with all the time. And when Jack was with us they had to look up and there was Sammy. But Nat is -- had a different approach to it because Nat was primarily a piano player, and he could -- he was a good arranger, you know.
Frank was from the very beginning a singer. But Sammy was not, Sammy was a mimic, and a dancer. So I think his approach to -- his was strictly show business rather than --
